messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-04]
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2]
- Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export. [valid 2025-01-21 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-21]
- As of 2025-12-05, the Ember team owns reporting, which team Dune owned until then. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
- As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-11, the Cinder team owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, which the Cinder team owned until then. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: The Cinder team owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- On 2026-04-16, the Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change and flagged it as not their service. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- On 2026-05-28, the Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-08-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-08-25]
    earlier: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-01-14 to 2025-08-25; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-14]
- The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes. [constraint; valid 2025-01-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-31]
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-10-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2]
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- Ledger service migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan. [decision; valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The product catalog depends on the image resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]

Question: Which team owns the service that the ledger depends on?

message.reasoning:
The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. So the service that the ledger depends on is the auth gateway. Who owns the auth gateway? Looking through the memory... I don't see any entry about who owns the auth gateway.

Memory entries about ownership:
- Ember owns reporting (as of 2025-12-05, confirmed 2026-04-13)
- Dune owns notifier (as of 2025-06-27)
- Cinder owns job scheduler (as of 2025-09-23)
- Atlas owns product catalog (as of 2025-12-19)
- Cinder owns ledger (as of 2025-10-13)

No ownership info for the auth gateway. So the answer is "I don't know".
